scope: Static source audit; does not execute network services or firewall rules

implementation.behavior: Private DNS, two REST services, Nginx round robin, trusted TLS, HTTP caching and original evidence
Independent backup DNS plus client DNS configuration and restore
TTL 30, real caching resolver, record changes and explicit cache flush
Backend PF isolation, strict edge allowlist, saved rules and rollback
Passive backend failover, retry limits, recovery and upstream logging
Separate standby key, same-CA certificate and DNS-based edge cutover
Layered diagnosis, controlled failures, command transcripts and packet capture

physical_demonstration: Not completed; source implementation is delivered separately from physical validation.
